content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"No—the corrected attribution credits connector numbering to River, login river-tools, account ID 2901.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"On 2026-07-01, a human report received through my code body tentatively identified River as Mara, while explicitly expressing uncertainty.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"HarborMesh checklist comment c1200 proposed numbering connectors before disassembly.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The human reporter said they wanted to try that proposal at the next repair.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"On 2026-07-04, a tool response received through my code body reported River's explicit denial of being Mara Ibarra and request for credit to the River account.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"Mara's known Forge account is 1847, login mara-river.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"River had not supplied a real name, and the supplied memories do not record whether connector numbering was tried.","support":[7],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
